rules: Only male players with a known birth date and a plausible active-professional birth year (1984-2010) are included.
A surviving membership must be PreferredRank or explicitly start in 2024 or later; undated historical memberships are rejected.
Generic defender, midfielder and forward data are preserved as factual roleGroup and are never promoted to CB/CM/ST facts.
Specific engine positions are factual only when a source names a specific role; OpenFootball G may map to GK, while D/M/F remain broad role groups.
Nationality and height are included only when explicitly available as Wikidata P27/P2048 statements; neither field is inferred.
Club identities come from the already-verified visual manifest; no second playable-club registry is maintained.
